dedupe_keys.name: b5g rural australia x haul planning benchmark inputs

description: This B5G benchmark package provides small and full JSON input sets for rural Australian radio-access and optical X-haul planning. The project publishes lists of radio, distributed and central units, candidate versus existing devices, road nodes and edges, route paths, user coverage maps and demand points. The small set supports quick tests; the full set supports larger deployment experiments. Files are available freely in the GitHub dataset folder under the root GPL-3.0 licence. A telecom modeller could compare greenfield and mixed-network deployment or tune capacity and coverage constraints in an optimization simulation. The inputs describe a regional design scenario, not measured live traffic; no observation period is stated. The dataset README explains that changing radio-unit coverage requires rebuilding the user map and that moving units requires recalculating paths. One mapping filename is singular in the guide but plural in the tree. This review did not read JSON values, verify coordinates or run algorithms. Related resources include the separate B5G planning models in the same repository and its standalone dataset generator.
licence: GPL-3.0 in root LICENSE and README; GitHub metadata labels the file Other rather than giving an SPDX identifier.
